<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies/templates"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves all global asset audit policy templates. Templates provide pre-configured audit policy definitions that can be used as starting points when creating new policies. Global templates are system-wide configurations that define common audit workflows, schedules, and settings. These templates help standardize audit processes across the organization and reduce setup time when implementing new audit policies. The returned templates include all policy configuration such as type, schedule, alert settings, and default asset targeting rules.
